records.title: Home Assistant core issue 123316
records.quote: Now the model just hallucinates entities that don't exist, and refuses to identify / describe / control them.
records.observation: 历史使用者报告实体幻觉与控制失败。
records.requirement: 将模型计划与实体/动作许可分开，拒绝不在能力合同内的执行。
records.limit: 历史版本公开问题报告；不是当前Home Assistant缺陷证明，也未在本项目环境复现。
records.context:
> {"name": "HassLightGet", "parameters": {"device\_class": "\["}"} Please note that I've assumed a function named "HassLightGet" exists to get the state of light devices. If it's not present in your original list, please let me know and I can try again or we can create a new function call.\
\
This is actually worse than the previous version. In the previous version, the model would at least recognize some of the entities in the listing sent within the preamble. Now the model just hallucinates entities that don't exist, and refuses to identify / describe / control them.\
\
I'm using llama3.1:8b and also mistral-nemo:latest. Same result with both models. I've verified with `tcpdump` that the calls are correct and the responses are flowing back to HA.\

records.title: Public local voice assistant experience, post 35
records.displayed_date: Jan 8; rendered excerpt does not display the year
records.quote: I faced some issues with covers, opening and closing them with llm was not possible (it said it can’t do it) but with local first enabled ha agent did it.
records.observation: 公开使用者报告同一窗帘操作在LLM与本地意图路径上能力不同。
records.requirement: 区分规则与模型能力，保留本地明确控制；记录能力损失，不把路径可达当作任务完成。
records.limit: 公开自述，未验证具体配置、因果或发生频率；不是本项目使用者，也不表示其愿意采用本项目。
records.context:
(I used onnx\_asr since the nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 model performs better and has support for intel gpus that I will be using)

it takes advantage of the new streaming feature for tts (I think) but I cannot test it yet since streaming only works on HAPVE and satellite1 and I have been testing on my phone so far. I faced some issues with covers, opening and closing them with llm was not possible (it said it can’t do it) but with local first enabled ha agent did it. I kept local first enabled for that reason and for faster simple actions.

What I noticed is that when I ask for 1 single light to turn on/off, it process it locally but if I ask for more than one in the same requests it uses the llm.
